prompt: He worked very hard. ___, he failed the exam.
explanation: Beklentiye ters düşen sonuç: « nevertheless » (yine de). Diğerleri sonuç ya da ekleme bildirir.

prompt: It was raining heavily; ___, we stayed at home.
explanation: İkinci cümle birincinin sonucu: « consequently » (bu yüzden).

prompt: Anna loves the theatre, ___ her brother prefers the cinema.
I won't go out ___ it stops raining.
explanation: « Unless » = “-medikçe”: yağmur dinmedikçe çıkmam. Diğerleri anlam olarak uymaz.

prompt: He is very competent. ___, he lacks experience.
explanation: Olumlu bir özelliğe karşı olumsuz bir özellik: « however » (ancak). « Moreover » ve « furthermore » aynı yönde ekler.

prompt: She couldn't come ___ her son was ill.
explanation: Neden bildirir: « because ». Diğerleri koşul ya da amaç bildirir.

prompt: Take an umbrella; ___, you'll get wet.
This restaurant is excellent. ___, it is very cheap.
explanation: Aynı yönde bir bilgi ekler: « moreover » (üstelik).

prompt: We missed the train; ___ we arrived late.
He got the job ___ his lack of experience.
explanation: Zıtlık bildirir: « despite » (-e rağmen). Diğerleri neden bildirir.

prompt: ___ the weather was terrible, the match went ahead.
The results were poor; ___, further research is needed.

I haven't seen her for five years.
The ___ five years ago.
answer: last time I saw her was
alternatives: last time I saw her was
explanation: « I haven't seen her for five years » = “the last time I saw her was five years ago”: for + süre yerine « the last time + past simple + was … ago ».

prompt:
It's a pity you didn't come.
I wish ___ come.
explanation: Geçmişteki pişmanlık için « wish + past perfect »: I wish you had come.

prompt:
Although it was cold, we went out.
We went out ___ the cold.
explanation: « Although » + cümle yerine « despite / in spite of » + isim: despite the cold.

prompt:
He is too young to drive.
He isn't ___ to drive.
explanation: « Too + sıfat » yerine olumsuz « not + sıfat + enough »: not old enough.

prompt:
People say he is a genius.
He ___ a genius.
explanation: « People say that… » edilgen yapı: he is said to be a genius.

prompt:
She started learning French three years ago.
She ___ French for three years.
explanation: Başlamış ve hâlâ süren eylem: present perfect continuous (has been learning + for).
